dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline with moderate curvature from apex to posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded geometry with an approximate 5-8 pixel radius at the maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 48 degrees relative to the dorsal longitudinal axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a broad radius; smooth transition from blowhole region to rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt projection; length-to-thickness ratio is approximately 1:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle (~150 degrees) at the melon-rostrum junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Non-biological cyan-colored mesh with uniform emissive shader; low-poly geometric structure visible on silhouette edges.
